description: Stations de réparation et lavage vélo des Alpes de Haute-Provence is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Alpes de Haute-Provence. Recensement des stations-services de lavage, gonflage et réparation des vélos. Le fichier précise les services disponibles et le mode de fonctionnement de chaque (généralement hors d'eau pendant l'hiver). Ces équipements (bornes en libre service) appartiennent à des collectivités locales qui en assurent directement la gestion ou la délèguent à d'autres entités. Coverage: Département des Alpes de Haute-Provence. The publisher named on the listing is Département des Alpes de Haute-Provence. Its keywords include cyclo, operation-libre, gonflage, borne, lavage, vtt. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
